items.headline: A spike in realized profit-taking
items.detail: Net realized profit today is 9.0σ from normal — coins are moving at a gain more than usual.
items.framing: Profit-taking spiked on-chain today (9.0σ). A behaviour read from what coins realised when they moved.
items.checkable: Realized P&L from the FIFO engine per moved coin.

items.headline: 9.07M SPX left in a day at a loss
items.detail: 2026-09-15: 50 wallets dropped below the 5k bar with 9.07M SPX, 9.6σ above the usual churn — loss-led (capitulation).
items.framing: A loss-led exit wave — the worrying kind: 50 wallets left 9.07M SPX underwater. Say "left/dropped below the bar", not "dumped".
items.checkable: Wallets whose balance fell below the 5k residency bar that day, split by exit vs entry price.

items.headline: A whale shed 6.88M SPX in 7 days
items.detail: 0x6157…981c distributed over the window, one of 3 whales net-selling.
items.framing: A large wallet distributed 6.88M SPX in 7 days. State it as a move off this wallet — it may be a split (see clustering), not a market sell.
items.checkable: Net balance change on a watched wallet over the last week of transfers.

items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by exchange flow
items.detail: The composite sits at the 30th percentile, but the exchange flow axis is at 74 while the rest average 34 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except exchange flow, which reads 74/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: Long-dormant coins are waking up
items.detail: Liveliness 0.613 is 2.3σ up vs its month. Rising = old coins moving (distribution/rotation); falling = holders sitting still (accumulation).
items.framing: Older coins are starting to move — liveliness ticked up. Interesting "the patient money is stirring" angle; not a direction call.
items.checkable: Coin-days-destroyed vs coin-days-stored from the FIFO reconstruction.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-16.9% over 12w)
items.detail: The 10-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 6.96M SPX. 4w -13.9% · 12w -16.9% · 26w -22.5%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-16.9% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.

items.headline: 1 new proven top-timer in 90 days
items.detail: Wallet(s) that just crossed the ROI+capital bar by selling a top at profit — a burst means distribution is starting.
items.framing: 1 wallet(s) newly qualified as smart money in 90d (sold a top at ≥5× ROI). Low count = quiet market; a spike is the tell.
items.checkable: First crossing of the ROI+capital bar per wallet, from the sale history.

items.headline: Supply is spreading out of the top 100
items.detail: Top-100 share is 56.4% of holder supply, 1.9σ down vs its month.
items.framing: The largest 100 wallets gave up share this month (56.4%, 1.9σ). Broadening holder base — decentralising.
items.checkable: Top-100 addresses' share of tracked supply, from the transfer history.
